_comment: common.json — shared environment, simulation, and data parameters.
_comment2: Used by: gen_maps, gen_demos, gen_bev_gifs, FlowDataset, BEVBuilder, trajectory_metrics.

map._comment: Square-world map geometry and obstacle randomisation.

bev._comment: BEV semantic grid. D_bev must match map.D_bev.

horizon._comment: path_scale > 1 allows detours around obstacles during demo generation.

controller._comment: Pure-pursuit / heading controller used during expert demo generation.

dataset._comment: Sliding-window dataset construction for FlowDataset. D_max is the distance normalisation upper bound for goal_vec.
